integrity: The claim is proved by explicit Euclidean limit calculations, a one-variable maximization with an exact radical stationary point, and continuity. High-precision computation only checks the algebra and finite representatives; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific limitations: Only necessary parameter conditions are proved. The result does not establish Liu’s conjecture on its stated interval, and the lower obstruction is exact only for the specified isosceles-apex boundary family; other families may impose a stronger lower restriction.
title: Exact boundary obstruction for Liu’s 2014 one-parameter triangle conjecture
